items.prompt: For 100000 values all equal to 2 and target 4, which type requirement follows from the pair count?

options.text: Signed 32-bit is sufficient because each input value is small.
options.why: Small values do not bound the number of distinct index pairs.

options.text: The result is at most 100000, one pair per arrival.
options.why: An arrival can pair with many earlier matching occurrences.

options.text: Floating arithmetic is required to represent the count.
options.why: The count is an exact integer, and Python integers preserve it.
n(n-1)/2 counts every index pair; use a sufficiently wide exact integer representation.

items.explanation: n(n-1)/2 counts every index pair; use a sufficiently wide exact integer representation.
